reading.summary_en: Aerial drone footage captures a active volcanic eruption, following a river of glowing red lava flowing down a hill toward the volcanic spatter cone spewing lava under an overcast sky.
reading.summary_tr: Havadan çekilen dron görüntülerinde, kapalı bir gökyüzü altında lav fışkırtan volkanik koniye doğru tepeden aşağı akan kor gibi kırmızı bir lav nehri takip ediliyor.

setting_clues.en: Volcanic landscape with active lava flow and spatter cone
setting_clues.tr: Aktif lav akıntısı ve volkan konisi içeren volkanik manzara

events.what: Aerial drone footage follows a stream of active lava flowing down a volcanic slope.
The drone flies close to the active volcanic cone spouting lava into the air.
